flags.summary: The closer stopped taking calls and blocked out his calendar with no fixed return date at the end of May, so any gap in this rep's call record for that period is a deliberate absence rather than a recording failure or a run of no-shows.
evidence: so Chris was like, you need some time off, and I was like, no, I'm going to hit my bonus. And then I'll take some time off.
I said to Chris I was like I'm gonna take the rest of the month off and I'm gonna block my calendar out for next week and when I'm ready I'm just gonna open it back up
there's not like a day I'm going to, I don't want to say I'm going to be back on Friday. I'm just going to block out next week and the rest of this week.
When should I open my calendar up? When I feel ready? / Yeah. When you feel ready to surf.

flags.summary: The closer understood the monthly bonus to qualify on new cash collected rather than payment plans and was told he had hit it regardless, which cuts against the same week's management pressure to convert instalments into paid-in-full.
evidence: Angelo messages me the next morning, by the way, you hit your bonus. I was like, what? Because I thought it was on new cash, not payment plans.
I was like, well, that's weird.
I don't care about hitting more, I just want to hit my bonus. It's the bare minimum. And then I was like, I'm only two deals away from hitting bonus.
I get texts from one of my leads. payment planned earlier in the month saying, Hey, can I put an Another 3k down? I was like, sure.

flags.summary: The closer describes running a pitch while angry and privately contemptuous of a couple for asking the price before committing, and that call converted to a paid-in-full sale the following day.
evidence: then I got a text from a lead that I had the day before, which I did, I prided the hell out of that call. Because she said, they said something that really pissed me off, like in the moment. And it was my last call. I was just in this like, ah, state.
The husband whispered in her and she said, yeah, how much is it so we can think about it? I was like, no, just get me to think about it before you even know how much it costs.
And I just, uh, I just, you know, handled the logistics. And then they messaged me the next day, hey, ready to move forward, can we pay in full?
Out of all the leads I had, that was the most least likely one that was ever going to do that.

flags.summary: The closer reports having previously worked a shift pattern he describes as leaving him unfit to serve prospects, and is planning a relocation that moves all his calls to a 19:00-to-midnight window.
evidence: Last time I was in Asia, I was in the Philippines and I was getting up at 4.30, taking sales calls at 6am. It was still dark and like, it was just kind of like, oh, you know
I was not in service for people because I was kind of pissed off that I had to get up at 4.30 and take sales calls.
I'll take them in the evening and it will be, I'll take calls from 7pm till midnight
I can only take five calls a day.
